test_title: PYST 38: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

In the year 1973, there were only 9 tiger reserves, but ______ the number has risen to fifty.
solution:
The correct answer is **gradually**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gradually:** slowly over a period of time or a distance.

 
 
• **Example:** Women have **gradually **started taking stand for their empowerment.
 
 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Consequently: **as a result; therefore.
 
• **Adamantly: **with great insistence or determination.
 
• **Technically: **according to the exact meaning, facts, etc.
